items.author: NBCUniversal
items.summary: SVP, Head of Studio Data & Insights — NBCUniversal — Universal City, CA (Hybrid, 4 days/week in office; relocation) — reposted Nov 25 (12h ago) — $275,000–$350,000 plus bonus and LTI. Seniority: SVP / Executive. Industry: Media & entertainment (Comcast subsidiary). Experience: years not stated (senior operator). Key skills: senior operator from a studio, streamer, network or entertainment tech; embedding and scaling data and analytics in creative, marketing and distribution orgs; leading multidisciplinary data and analytics teams at scale; hiring and developing senior leaders; C-suite entertainment relationships; technical and analytical fluency; film/TV content lifecycle; AI-enabled decision support; platform roadmap input; matrixed leadership; superior analytical, presentation and communication skills; BA/BS required, MBA or JD preferred. No tools named.
